faqIntro: Find quick answers to typical queries regarding customized delivery, contractor services, warranty coverage, and care.

faqs.question: How long does custom delivery take?
faqs.answer: Standard freight typically arrives in 2–3 weeks; custom-built ovens add 1–2 weeks of build time. We'll confirm a window when you order.

faqs.question: Do I need a professional contractor for installation?
faqs.answer: No. Ovens arrive assembled and only need a level base. White-glove delivery and placement is available if you'd like it done for you.

faqs.question: What kind of warranty is included with my Brasa oven?
faqs.answer: Every Brasa carries a 2-year premium warranty on the refractory chamber against defects in materials and workmanship.

faqs.question: Can I request a completely custom-built brick oven?
faqs.answer: Yes — reach out with your vision and our specialists will design a one-off build around your space and cooking style.

faqs.question: What is your return policy for refractory clay ovens?
faqs.answer: Unused ovens in original condition can be returned within the return window. Custom configurations may be non-returnable; we'll walk you through the details.
